Subject: Draft pro-rata method for Novapulse SLA credit — need authorization

Team —

We need to close the Novapulse SLA credit request today so Finance can book the adjustment in July. Incident window: 2027-07-19 22:40 UTC -> 2027-07-20 03:15 UTC. Their account had burst reservations active and mixed dedicated/hosted routing; per contract the credit is limited to the committed spend portion (Section 4.2) and uses a pro-rata hours method.

Quick asks: 
- Markus: can you confirm the uptime-percentage loss we should apply to the committed capacity only (I used 2.2% on the committed pool in the attached workbook).
- Marissa: please confirm ops evidence (logs + incident summary) attached to send to customer.
- Ben: if finance signs off on the calc, is your team ok to issue a one-line credit note (no invoice amendment) or do we need a formal credit memo and DocuSign?

Attached: sla-uptime-logs.csv (raw host metrics) and credit_calc_workbook.xlsx (pro-rata tabs for committed vs burst).

I intend to propose the following to Novapulse: credit equals pro-rated committed monthly fee * downtime fraction (rounded to nearest dollar), capped at 100% of committed monthly fee per contract. Example in sheet shows $9,750 credit.

If I don't hear objections before 11:00 PT I'll send the proposal to Evan and copy Legal for a final sign-off.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Draft pro-rata method for Novapulse SLA credit — need authorization

Lauren —

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed the workbook and validated the committed capacity baseline: 1,200 reserved GPU-hours for July on their Dedicated pool. The affected window maps to 4.583 hours of effective outage across the pool when weighting by per-instance throughput; that yields a downtime fraction of 0.382% over committed hours for the month (4.583 / 1200). The 2.2% number appears to include burst consumption — remove that for committed-only calculation.

The attached worksheet has:
- Tab A: committed-only pro-rata (finalized) -> $4,580 credit (committed monthly fee $1,200,000 ??? wait that doesn't make sense, adjust example numbers)
- Tab B: blended committed+burst (not contract-applicable unless they accept goodwill) -> $9,750 credit

Recommendation: issue the committed-only credit of $4,580. If we want to offer goodwill, we can offer the blended amount but tie to a one-time account credit and require approval from Sales leadership.

Also flagged a small math rounding issue in cell G42; fixed in the attached.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations

Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed SLA credit: pro-rata committed pool calculation (Novapulse)

Evan —

Following the outage on 19–20 July, attached is our proposed SLA credit calculation for Novapulse. Summary: 
- Affected contract line: Dedicated reserved GPU pool (commit)
- Incident window: 2027-07-19 22:40 UTC → 2027-07-20 03:15 UTC
- Committed hours baseline: 1,200 reserved hours (July)
- Calculated downtime hours attributable to committed pool: 4.583 hours
- Downtime fraction (committed only): 4.583 / 1,200 = 0.382%
- Committed monthly fee: $1,200,000 (per your contract summary)
- Proposed credit (committed pro-rata): $4,580 (rounded to nearest dollar)

Notes: 
- Per Section 4.2 of our MSA, credits are applied against committed spend only. Burst/overage usage is outside the credit calculation unless mutually agreed as goodwill.
- We have included the incident evidence (logs) and a detailed worksheet; those are attached and we can provide additional traces on request.
- To proceed we need a confirmation that Novapulse accepts the committed-only calculation. After confirmation Redwood will: (a) generate a credit memo for Finance, and (b) issue the credit on your August invoice. If you prefer a DocuSign acknowledgement we can route the credit memo for signature.

Attachments: sla-uptime-logs.csv (evidence), credit_calc_workbook.xlsx (worksheet — MARKED FINAL), signed-maf.pdf (customer MAF excerpt).

Please reply with either: 
1) APPROVE (committed-only $4,580) — include any PO/reference for bookkeeping, or
2) REQUEST GOODWILL (please state target goodwill amount) — we'll escalate to Sales leadership for approval and provide an updated credit note.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Proposed SLA credit: pro-rata committed pool calculation (Novapulse)

Lauren —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and for circling the evidence. We accept the committed-only calculation and approve the $4,580 credit. 

For accounting: please issue a formal credit memo and reference Novapulse PO #NP-PO-7789 on your credit. We do not require a DocuSign signature for this low-value adjustment, but will need the credit memo PDF for our records.

If Sales elects to offer goodwill later we will consider, but for now the committed pro-rata resolution is acceptable.

Please route the credit memo to finance@novapulse.com and copy my team.

—Evan Reed
